patch_description: This redesign uses a stateful annealing engine rather than repeatedly rebuilding full candidate arrays. It keeps points in normalized barycentric coordinates, updates one point at a time, caches triangle areas, and only recomputes the 45 determinants affected by a moved point. Active low-area triangles guide many proposals, improving maximin refinement, while deterministic seeded restarts preserve reproducibility. A final strict polishing phase improves the actual minimum-area objective before conversion to Cartesian coordinates.
